name: forge
description: Claude proposes a new mod; nothing is written until you approve it in a dialog. Also suggests a mod when the same tool-call sequence repeats

forgeDir.title: Where forged mods go
forgeDir.description: Folder a forged mod is written to; <name> is replaced by the mod's name (appended when missing). ~ is your home folder. An existing folder is never overwritten.

suggestRepeats.title: Suggest a mod for repeated work
suggestRepeats.description: When the same sequence of 3 or more shell or MCP calls has run 3 times, offer to have Claude propose a mod for it.

approvalWaitSeconds.title: Seconds the tool call waits for you
approvalWaitSeconds.description: How long the forge call holds for your answer before it returns 'pending' (the engine caps a hook near 10 seconds; the dialog stays open and the answer reaches Claude as a message). 0 always returns pending.
